_comment: Supervision values per harness, used by the builders of E2 to E13. bounded_wait_s and progress_s come from V1. ack and ack_deadline_s are measured by E1 (2026-10-03): deadline = max(p99.9 ack latency x 1.5, longest provider stall) + 5 s; OpenCode stalled a live worker for 120.8 s after an offer, so its deadline equals the silence limit and the acknowledgement is informational (fallback of E1). silence_grace_s is confirmed by E2. idle_wakeups and token_budget are the values E3 measures.
